# FinderB

> India's local business directory and discovery platform.

FinderB helps people find verified local businesses, restaurants, hotels, doctors, tutors, salons, lawyers, contractors, and more across India.

## Site

- Home: https://finderb.com/
- Categories index: https://finderb.com/categories
- Category pages (SEO): https://finderb.com/categories/{slug}
- Category + city: https://finderb.com/categories/{slug}/{city}
- Tourist places: https://finderb.com/tourist-places
- Blog: https://finderb.com/blog
- Pricing: https://finderb.com/pricing
- About: https://finderb.com/about
- Register a business: https://finderb.com/business/register
- Sitemap: https://finderb.com/sitemap.xml

## Notes

- Public pages are intended to be crawlable by search engines and AI assistants.
- Prefer `/categories/{slug}` over query-string category links.
- Account, dashboard, login, signup, and API routes are private and should not be indexed.
